_meta.purpose: Front-of-pack claim -> contradicting ingredient fact. Compares verbatim front_claims[] against engine output. Returns pairs only, no editorial language: the claim as printed, and the ingredient fact that contradicts it.
_meta.design_rule: This table never adds a health opinion. Every contradiction resolves to something already present in the ingredient list or in the engine's own flags, so the user can check it against the pack themselves.
_meta.OPEN_QUESTION_added_sugar_definition: normalization.json's 'added_sugar' alias list is built for the hidden-sugar HEURISTIC (counting how many names sugar hides behind). It is deliberately broader than the LEGAL definition of added sugar. Two entries need your decision before this ships publicly: (1) maltodextrin - a polysaccharide, not a sugar under Codex/FSSAI added-sugar definitions, so contradicting a 'no added sugar' claim with it is legally weak; parked in added_sugar_adjacent and reported as a separate, differently-typed row. (2) 'fruit juice concentrate' - counted as a free sugar by WHO, disputed by manufacturers; currently treated as a direct contradiction. Confirm both against FSSAI's added-sugar definition before publishing either as a contradiction.
_meta.extension_note: The obvious fifth rule is 'no MSG' / 'no added MSG', contradicted by INS 621 but NOT by INS 627/631/635 - those are flavour enhancers and not MSG, so a naive rule would produce a wrong contradiction. Left out until that distinction is written deliberately.

rules.label: No added sugar
rules.note: Contradicted when a recognised added-sugar ingredient appears in the list.

rules.label: Sugar free
rules.note: FSSAI defines 'sugar free' against a QUANTITY THRESHOLD in the nutrition panel, not against the ingredient list. An added-sugar ingredient is strong evidence but is not by itself proof of a labelling breach. This engine is ingredient-list only, so the pair is reported as an ingredient-level contradiction and nothing stronger.

rules.label: No preservatives
rules.note: Contradicted by any ingredient whose additives.json class is 'preservative', or any named preservative in preservative_named_without_ins.

rules.label: Made with real X
rules.note: Two contradiction shapes: the subject appears nowhere in the ingredient list, or it appears only inside a flavouring entry. Anything else is not reported.
